DATED: 21/04/2023  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION NO. 410 of 2014 ==========================================================
 VALJIBHAI CHHAGANBHAI NAVADIYA  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & 1 other(s)
==========================================================
Appearance:
MR. BHADRISH S RAJU(6676) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR HK PATEL, ADDL. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent(s) No. 1 RULE SERVED BY DS for the Respondent(s) No. 1,2 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE J. C. DOSHI  Date : 21/04/2023

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
ORAL ORDER 1. Heard learned advocate Mr. Bhadrish Raju for the petitioner as well as learned APP Mr. Patel for the respondent State.
2. Rule is served to respondent No.2 - Sejalben Kalubhai Maniya, but she chose not to appear before the Court and contest this quashing petition.

3. By way of this petition filed under Article 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the petitioner seeks quashment of FIR being I - C.R. No.66 of 2013 registered with Mahila Police Station, Surat City inter alia on the grounds mentioned in the petition.

4. During the argument of this petition, learned advocate Mr. Raju brought to the notice of this Court oral order dated R/CR.MA/410/2014 ORDER DATED: 21/04/2023 19.10.2015 passed by the Coordinate Bench in Criminal Misc. Application No.19683 of 2015, whereby, FIR against rest of other accused, who are husband and in-laws of the respondent No.2 has been quashed and set aside.
Learned advocate Mr. Raju would further submit that status of the present petitioner is that of maternal uncle (mama) of Shaileshkumar i.e. husband of the respondent No.2 herein.

Para 2, 3 and 4 of the oral order as mentioned herein above, the Coordinate Bench observed thus:-

sentences.text:
By this application under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the petitioners seek to invoke the inherent powers of this court, praying for quashing of the first information report being I C.R. No. 66 of 2013 lodged before the Mahila Police Station, Surat City of the offence punishable under sections 498(A), 323, 504,
506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code on the ground that there has been an amicable settlement between the parties and the respondent No.2- original complainant is no longer desirous of prosecuting the first information report further.
The respondent No.2-Sejalben W/o. Shaileshkumar Maniya is personally present and she confirms about the settlement arrived at with the accused persons.
The respondent No.2- Smt. Sejalben is identified by her learned advocate Ms. Bela Prajapati.

Smt. Sejalben has also filed an affidavit, inter alia, stating as under:
"I, Sejal Maniya, wife of Shailesh K. Maniya, and daughter of Amarsinhbhai Donda,
Aged : Adult, Residing at 404, Chitrakut Flats, Block No.33, Near Jail Ground,
Anantvadi, Bhavnagar, respondent no.2 herein, do hereby state on solemn affirmation as under:- 1.

I say that I have lodged FIR being C.R. No.I- 66/13 with Mahila Poilce Station, Surat, for the offences punishable under Section 438A, 323,
504, 506(2), 114 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Sections 3 and 7 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
I say that I have lodged aforesaid FIR under some misconception and understanding.
I say that after mutual understanding the petitioner no.1 and myself have arrived at settlement and I no longer want to prosecute R/CR.MA/410/2014 ORDER DATED: 21/04/2023 the petitioners.
I say that the FIR is without any foundation and at the time when the said FIR was lodged, I was not in proper frame of mind.
I say that facing of criminal complaint by anybody would cause harassment to the said person.
I say that the deed of divorce is executed by myself and the petitioner no.1 by mutual consent.
I say that there is no difference of opinion or any dispute between myself and the petitioners.
I say that after marriage there were some doubts between myself and the petitioner no.1.
Said grudges have reached to an extent that myself and the petitioner no.1 are no longer able to reside together under one roof.
I say that, therefore, the divorce deed is also executed between myself and petitioner no.1.
I say that family members and the elders of the community have intervened and the dispute and the grievance between myself and the petitioner no.1 no longer survives.
I say that the petitioners are not involved in commission of alleged offence.

I say that it would be futile exercise if the petitioners are prosecuted and, therefore, FIR lodged by me being C.R. No.I-66/13 before Mahila Police Station,
Surat is required to be quashed.

Solemnly affirmed on this 9th day of September, 2015."
3.

Taking into consideration the nature of the dispute and the fact that the parties have now amicably decided to live peacefully, no useful purpose would be served to allow the police to continue with the investigation of the said first information report.

sentences.text: In the result, this application is allowed.
The first information report being I C.R. No. 66 of 2013 lodged before the Mahila Police Station, Surat City is hereby ordered to be quashed.
All consequential proceedings arising from the same also stand terminated.
Rule is made absolute.
The Registry shall accept the Vakalatnama of Ms. Bela Prajapati, the learned advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent No.2."

5. Upon such statement, learned advocate Mr. Raju for the petitioner would submit that when the FIR is quashed against R/CR.MA/410/2014 ORDER DATED: 21/04/2023 the main accused, there is no useful purpose for keeping the FIR pending against the present petitioner, who is even not remotely connected with the alleged offence u/s 498A, 323, 324, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the IPC and therefore, urged to quash and set aside the impugned FIR.

6. Having heard learned advocates for both the sides, at the outset, considering the order passed by the Coordinate Bench on 19.10.2015 in Criminal Misc. Application No.19683 of 2015, it appears that the grievance between the complainant and the main accused has been settled, divorce took place between them and in that circumstances, since dispute does not survive, there is no question to continue present FIR against the present petitioner, who is maternal uncle of main accused Shaileshkumar Kalubhai Mania.
It is also not disputed that the present petitioner is not staying with the original complainant.
7. Thus, without entering into further merits of the case, I found it to be fit case to quash the FIR.
In the result, this Criminal Misc. Application is allowed and the FIR being I - C.R. No.66 of 2013 registered with Mahila Police Station, Surat City qua present petitioner
is hereby quashed and set aside.
All consequential proceedings arising from the same also stands terminated.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.

(J. C. DOSHI,J) SHEKHAR P. BARVE Valjibhai Chhaganbhai Navadiya vs State Of Gujarat on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39289778/
